sourceData.mnemonic: Take your <kanji>name</kanji> and <kanji>stab</kanji> someone with it... using your <vocabulary>business card</vocabulary>. Your business card has your name on it. Also, you "stab" it at people who are willing to take it and read it. Not a real stab, but a metaphorical.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: This is a jukugo word, which usually means on'yomi readings from the kanji. If you know the readings of your kanji you'll know how to read this as well.
